NO₂

Most modern cars are fitted with catalytic converters in the exhaust system.
Which three gases are removed by a catalytic converter?

options.B: carbon monoxide, carbon dioxide, nitrogen oxides
options.C: carbon monoxide, nitrogen oxides, sulfur dioxide

pollutant
chemical removal

Which emission from an internal combustion engine contributes to the erosion of marble statues?
carbon monoxide

Which statement about the oxides of nitrogen is correct?
During lightning storms, atmospheric oxygen and nitrogen combine to form oxides of nitrogen.

options.A: In a catalytic converter, nitrogen monoxide is removed by reaction with carbon dioxide.
options.B: In car engines, the restricted supply of oxygen eliminates the possibility of the formation of oxides of nitrogen.
options.C: In the atmosphere, nitrogen monoxide reacts with sulfur dioxide to produce sulfur trioxide.

stem:
Nitrogen dioxide is a gas that contributes to air pollution. It is produced in internal combustion
engines.
Which statement is correct?

options.A: Nitrogen dioxide acts as a catalyst in the atmospheric oxidation of sulfur dioxide to sulfur trioxide.
options.B: Nitrogen dioxide reacts to form nitrogen monoxide in the catalytic converter of a car exhaust system.
options.C: PAN forms when nitrogen dioxide reacts with the gases formed by complete combustion of the fuel.
options.D: Under high pressure in an internal combustion engine, nitrogen dioxide forms from impurities in the fuel.

catalytic converter?

options.A: 12 g of carbon and 92 g of nitrogen dioxide
options.B: 24 g of carbon and 92 g of nitrogen dioxide
options.C: 88 g of carbon dioxide and 28 g of nitrogen
options.D: 88 g of carbon dioxide and 56 g of nitrogen
